description: Google Charts API - Create professional charts in Google Sheets and embed them in Google Docs. Supports 10+ chart types with full customization.

tools.name: google_charts_create
tools.short_description: Create professional Google Chart in new Sheet with 10+ chart types and full customization
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) ALWAYS execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER reference 'I created earlier' or use conversation history
(2) MUST return format: **[Name]** | ID: `[id]` | URL: [full_url] | Link: [title](url)
(3) Use EXACT values from tool response - NEVER make up fake URLs/IDs

Create a professional Google Chart in a new Google Sheet. Supports 10+ chart types (column, bar, line, area, pie, scatter, combo, histogram, candlestick, bubble) with full customization including colors, titles, axis labels, stacking, and legend positioning. The chart is embedded in a shareable spreadsheet for easy viewing and editing.

data.description: 2D array of chart data. First column = labels (x-axis/categories), remaining columns = data series. Example: [['Jan', 10, 20], ['Feb', 15, 25], ['Mar', 12, 22]]

headers.description: Optional header row for columns. Example: ['Month', 'Sales', 'Expenses']

chart_options.description: Optional chart customization: title, subtitle, x_axis_title, y_axis_title, width (px), height (px), position {row, col}, legend_position (bottom/top/left/right/none), colors (hex array like ['#1a73e8', '#34a853']), stacked (bool)

returns.description: Chart result with spreadsheet_id, sheet_id, chart_id, URL, title, and chart_type

Create a Google Chart and insert it as an image into a Google Doc. This function creates a temporary spreadsheet with the chart, exports it as an image, and embeds it in the document. Perfect for adding visual data representations to reports, presentations, and documents.

document_id.description: Target Google Doc ID where chart will be inserted

chart_data.description: Chart data structure with 'headers' (array) and 'data' (2D array). Example: {'headers': ['Month', 'Sales'], 'data': [['Jan', 100], ['Feb', 150]]}

chart_options.description: Optional chart customization: title, subtitle, x_axis_title, y_axis_title, width (px), height (px), colors (hex array), legend_position, stacked (bool)

insertion_index.description: Position in document to insert chart (null = end of document)

returns.description: Insert result with inserted (bool), image_url, temp_spreadsheet_id, chart_type, and insertion_index
